description.name: FeatureDesk - Category Spec Boxes & Server Notices
description.tagline: Responsive 4-column feature checklists, server backup notices, and custom HTML boxes below WHMCS pricing cards
description.long: FeatureDesk v2.0 is an ultra-modern WHMCS addon module by Bahari IT that renders custom responsive category feature checklists, server backup advisory notices, and dynamic HTML blocks directly below product cards per product group, leaving native product descriptions 100% untouched.
features: Category-based custom HTML Feature Spec Boxes per WHMCS Product Group
Ready-to-use responsive 4-column Advanced Features checklist starter template
Dedicated Server Backup Notice box with responsive alert styling
Dynamic expandable custom HTML boxes per category
Strict zero-touch guarantee: native pricing cards and product descriptions remain untouched
100% responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
One-click starter templates built directly into the admin dashboard
